EmailTemplate.subject: What’s inefficient invoice-to-cash costing you?
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {{lead.First Name:default=Friend}}, Fragmented invoice-to-cash processes, from invoicing to reconciliation, can quietly erode your revenue and slow global growth.
Whether it’s manual workflows, payment delays, or lack of visibility across systems, inefficient A/R comes at a real cost.
88% of CFOs say the challenges of cross-border collections impact global expansion.
In our recent session on the ROI of an All-in-One A/R Strategy <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/webinar-the-roi-of-an-all-in-one-ar-strategy?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>, we discussed how a modern, integrated approach to invoice-to-cash can streamline operations, reduce DSO, and boost cash flow.
The result? An annual savings of up to 62%.
Let me know if you’d like a personalized ROI assessment—we’d love to show you what’s possible.
Best, Hope Kim
